model.head: Linear(64, 4)
model.output_activation: tanh when all source targets lie in [-1,1], otherwise identity (recorded in run.json)

preprocessing.step2: divide by per-sample mean over all voxels and channels (1.0 if mean == 0)

cudnn_policy.on_failure: set torch.backends.cudnn.enabled = False and continue on the same CUDA device with generic CUDA kernels
